- **Canvas Background**: Pure deep black `#020202` spanning full viewport height (`min-h-[100dvh]`, `h-[100dvh]`, `overflow-hidden`, `select-none`).

The background runs on an HTML5 `<canvas>` animated via `requestAnimationFrame`:
1. **Coordinates**:
   - Desktop: Center X `cx = width * 0.75`, Center Y `cy = height * 0.48`. Base radius `baseRadius = max(min(width * 0.22, height * 0.36), 230)`.

   - Dark hollow center void: `ctx.filter = 'blur(34px)'; ctx.fillStyle = '#020202'; ctx.arc(cx, cy, curRadius * 0.54, 0, Math.PI * 2)`.
3. **Left Side (Blurred Slit-Scan Glass Strips)**:
   - 8 distinct vertical louvers on desktop (6 on mobile) occupying the left semicircle width (`totalWidth = curRadius * 1.35`).
   - Vertical harmonic displacement: `stepY = Math.sin(slicePhase) * 6 + ((i % 2 === 0) ? -3.5 : 3.5)`.
   - Frosted optical strip gradients, interior glow lines, and fine vertical glass divider lines.
   - Atmospheric edge bleed and linear feathering so the leftmost edge fades smoothly into `#020202` without any hard boundary cuts.
4. **Dividing Meridian**:
   - Soft glow line (`blur: 4px, stroke: 3px, color: rgba(152,255,104,0.35)`) and hairline center tick (`lineWidth: 1px, color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`) at X = `cx`.

The application must be a 100vw x 100vh full-screen poster-style interactive editorial artwork that combines 3D collectible mascot visuals with high-end graphic design, smooth mouse parallax, interactive sound synthesis, and animated water ripples.

================================================================================
1. DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS & TOKENS
================================================================================

A. PALETTE & ATMOSPHERE:
- Sky Top: #4CCBE8
- Sky Mid-Upper: #59D1EA
- Sky Middle: #65D9EF
- Ground Transition: #D4F4FA fading down to #F2FAFC
- Platform Water Tone: #23B8DB / #168FC5 / #0E6C9E
- Platform Sand Tone: #E7C27B / #DDB77A / #F5DC9E
- Text & Outlines: Primary Black #050505, Pure White #FFFFFF, Microcopy Charcoal #1F1F1F
- Subtle background noise: 3.5% opacity SVG fractalNoise filter for authentic printed editorial poster texture.

B. TYPOGRAPHY & GOOGLE FONTS:
- Montserrat (Weights: 400, 600, 700, 800, 900)
- Archivo Black (Weight: 400)
- Space Mono (Weight: 400, 700)
- Chakra Petch (Weight: 600, 700)
Embed link:
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=Chakra+Petch:ital,wght@0,600;0,700;1,700&family=Montserrat:wght@400;600;800;900&family=Space+Mono:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

C. EXACT IMAGE ASSETS:
1. 3D Character (PAIPAI on Snowboard + floating green monster companion):
   URL: "https://res.cloudinary.com/chhwhdhk/image/upload/v1788509773/4ede3e25-0ad7-46eb-95dd-06495341141b_zzgvpi.png"
2. Base Island Platform (Sand beach + turquoise sculpted ocean water cylinder):
   URL: "https://res.cloudinary.com/chhwhdhk/image/upload/v1788509700/c0cfd993-d10d-4283-a9cf-6b3b2fbc29dd_j7ie6k.png"

D. DEPTH & Z-INDEX LAYERING (BACK TO FRONT):
1. z-[-20]: Atmospheric sky gradient & grain texture overlay.
2. z-[0]: Giant white blurred background typography "PAIPAI" (with filter: blur(8px)), wide spaced subtitle "K U A I S H O U   C U L T U R E", and outlined top-right "KUAISHOU".
3. z-[10]: Base island platform with ground ambient shadow.
4. z-[15]: Three.js WebGL canvas providing soft directional lighting and water shimmer.
5. z-[20]: Central 3D character and snowboard hovering slightly overlapping the platform top.
6. z-[30]: Editorial microcopy, lower-left "#04 /运动派*", middle-right rotating circular "KID" stamp, and lower-right 3-angle orthographic blueprint illustrations.
7. z-[40]: Top header with PAIPAI mascot face badge and three interactive circular utility controls.

================================================================================
2. ANIMATION & INTERACTION SPECIFICATIONS
================================================================================

1. MOUSE PARALLAX (Interactive Depth):
   Tracks normalized cursor position (-1 to 1):
   - Background giant text: subtle parallax factor (2px)
   - Island platform: medium parallax factor (4px)
   - Central character: strong parallax factor (8px)
   - Three.js camera: responds smoothly with 0.05 lerp interpolation.
   - Respects 'prefers-reduced-motion' by disabling all camera and object parallax when active.

2. CHARACTER TRICK ANIMATION:
   Clicking the character triggers a dynamic carve jump (y: [-22, 10, 0], rotate: [-4, 3, 0]) and plays an interactive audio pop.

3. WATER RIPPLE:
   Clicking the platform triggers an expanding wave ring animation and plays a synthesized water splash sound.

4. WEB AUDIO SYNTHESIZER:
   A zero-dependency Web Audio API synthesizer that produces:
   - Pop tone (440Hz -> 880Hz sine ramp) on clicks.
   - Water splash tone (320Hz -> 140Hz triangle ramp).
   - Chime chords (C5, E5, G5, C6 arpeggio) when clicking badges or the sound toggle.

5. ROTATING EDITORIAL STAMP:
   The middle-right badge features text running around a circle ("• KUAI INTERESTING DESIGN •") spinning infinitely at 18 seconds per rotation, with a central faceted KID badge that scales on hover.

================================================================================
3. EXACT CODE IMPLEMENTATION
================================================================================
1. index.html
2. src/utils/audio.ts
3. src/components/Background.tsx
4. src/components/Header.tsx
5. src/components/CharacterArt.tsx
6. src/components/IslandPlatform.tsx
7. src/components/EditorialElements.tsx
8. src/components/ThreeCanvas.tsx
9. src/App.tsx
